definition: to take something out of a container
description: A laughing young woman in a plum satin dress stands barefoot on a long white table at an outdoor evening wedding dinner in an orchard under string lights. She lifts a golden retriever puppy out of a big open wicker hamper, hugs it and holds it up high. A second puppy walks along the table past a half-eaten cake, leaving muddy paw prints on the tablecloth among tipped-over glasses. A young man in a suit at the table reaches out, and guests behind cheer with raised arms.

taps.phrase: to lift a puppy up high
